action_items: Update ComponentAuthority.principal exception mapping to convert PrincipalRefusal/RuntimeError-style unknown-principal lookups into Held(PRINCIPAL_NOT_ADMITTED).

rca of the issue: Reproduction: run supplemental suite command above. Failure path: execution_send.claim_send -> MkondoHandoff.prepare -> receiver() -> authority.principal(receiver_id).
